primaryTextRead.text: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

wikipediaRead.title: Ephrath
wikipediaRead.locator: Ephrath article lead lines 112–115 identifies variant spellings and Caleb’s wife who bore Hur; “Personal name” section line 130 repeats Ephrath/Ephrathah.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 記事はエフラト／エフラタを同じ名の異表記と説明し、カレブの妻がフルを産んだと述べる。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessment: Exact personal-name section; same page also has a separate geographic Ephrath usage, not used for this profile.

candidateOccurrenceReview.reasonJa: 2:19はカレブがエフラトと結婚し、彼女がフルを産んだと明記する。
2:50はフルをエフラタの長子と呼ぶ。
4:4はフルをエフラタの長子とし、その後にベツレヘムの父という表現を置く。

decisionNotesJa: 初出欄の修正: 初出の2:19にない後続のエフラタ表記を注記から外し、2:19のカレブの妻という説明に限定。
